Spacecraft name SMOG-2
Type PocketQube
Units or mass PocketQube 3p
Status cancelled
Organisation Budapest University of Technology and Economics
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Country Hungary
Oneliner

Spectrum monitoring pocketqube class satellites with wider monitored spectrum range.
Description

SMOG-2 is the continuation of SMOG-P and SMOG-1 spectrum monitoring pocketqube class satellites with wider monitored spectrum range, focused on HAM, ISM and broadcasting bands, made by university students, integrated into the higher education.

With SMOG-2 we are able to measure the electromagnetic pollution not only on the broadcasting bands but also on HAM, ISM and WiFi bands. The help of worldwide radio amateur stations can receive its spectrum monitoring data and we can create the global electromagnetic pollution map. The monitored frequency bands are public.
